name: Enology Wine Bar & Bistro
aliases: Enology Wine Bar & Bistro Saint James
description: A wine-focused bar and bistro on North Country Road in St. James. Local singers and acoustic players perform early evening sets, usually on Thursdays from 6 to 8 PM.

dancing.notes: The venue describes its music nights as early sets at a conversation-friendly volume, with limited seating and reservations suggested. Plan on sitting and listening; we found no dance floor or dancing.

evidence.note: Venue music page says sets are early and conversation-friendly with limited seating, and lists Thursday 6 to 8 PM sets in October 2026.
Contact page gives the street address, phone and hours: open Tuesday to Saturday evenings, closed Sunday and Monday.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05) for source enology-wine-bar-bistro-saint-james. The website says it is closed for a short break from October 4 to 12, 2026 and reopens October 13.
